scope: Microdiagnostic of unmodified production pure planning functions with an offline resource constructor. No weights, CUDA initialization, sessions, tensor allocation, serving execution or complete-request causal attribution.
measurement_notes: Unprofiled timings and cProfile are separate; profiler overhead is not subtracted from serving time.
All samples are retained. Timing calls execute serially with GC enabled; isolated cost estimates are not additive.
AllocationSpec reconstruction uses prebuilt kwargs and includes a Python loop/tuple; existing-object validation excludes construction.
Internal scan inputs were observed in one untimed call via a temporary local-process wrapper, restored before all timing.
The optimized warm hit rebuilds geometry and SessionPlan; its SessionPlan validation retains one full footprint scan. Cold misses additionally execute the complete original layout scans.

hbm.timed_plan_mode: plan_runtime_session uses an established matching cache; forced_cold_miss clears the local diagnostic backend field before each call.
